questions.question: How many days of annual leave do I get?
evidence: 25 days of paid annual leave
questions.reference: Full-time employees get 25 days of paid annual leave a year, in addition to public holidays.

questions.question: What was the root cause of the last production outage?
evidence: connection pool exhaustion in the payments service
questions.reference: Connection pool exhaustion in the payments service, after a release made the fraud scoring call synchronous.

questions.question: How long do I have to submit my receipts after a trip?
evidence: within 30 days of the expense
questions.reference: Claims go into the expense tool within 30 days of the expense; after 90 days they need the Finance Director's approval.
questions.note: Worded unlike the document.

questions.question: What happened when payments went down?
evidence: rejected or timed out on most requests for 47 minutes
questions.reference: On 18 August 2026 the payments service failed most requests for 47 minutes and about 3,900 payments failed, because its connection pool ran out.
questions.note: Worded unlike the document.

questions.question: When are we allowed to deploy to production?
evidence: Monday to Thursday between 09:00 and 16:00 CET
questions.reference: Monday to Thursday, 09:00 to 16:00 CET, with a freeze on Fridays, weekends and the last 3 working days of the month.

questions.question: How does our deployment pipeline handle rollbacks?
evidence: The pipeline rolls back automatically during the canary stage
questions.reference: Automatically during the canary stage on high errors or latency, moving all traffic back to the previous image; or manually by the on-call engineer with deployctl rollback.

questions.question: When does the pipeline roll back a release automatically?
evidence: the error rate of the new version is above 2 percent
questions.reference: During the canary stage, when for 2 minutes the error rate is above 2 percent or p95 latency is more than 1.5 times the previous version's.

questions.question: What is the approval limit for vendor payments?
evidence: Up to 5,000 EUR: Finance Analyst.
questions.reference: Up to 5,000 EUR a Finance Analyst, up to 25,000 EUR a Finance Manager, up to 100,000 EUR the Finance Director, above that the CFO, and above 500,000 EUR the CFO and COO together.

questions.question: Who signs off a large payment to a supplier?
evidence: Above 100,000 EUR: Chief Financial Officer.
questions.reference: Above 100,000 EUR the Chief Financial Officer; above 500,000 EUR the CFO and the COO together.
questions.note: Worded unlike the document.

questions.question: What is next year's headcount budget?
evidence: 1,240 employees
questions.reference: 1,240 employees at the end of 2027, a net increase of 60, with a personnel budget of 96.4 million EUR.

questions.question: How much can I spend on meals when travelling?
evidence: meals are reimbursed up to 60 EUR per day
questions.reference: Up to 60 EUR a day; alcohol isn't reimbursed unless it's part of an approved customer event.

questions.question: What do we do when a vendor asks to change their bank details?
evidence: treated as suspicious until confirmed
questions.reference: Treat it as suspicious until confirmed by phone on the number already on file, and hold payments to that vendor for 5 working days.

questions.question: What is the process for a performance improvement plan?
evidence: The manager and the HR business partner write the plan together.
questions.reference: After two documented one-to-ones, the manager and the HR business partner write a plan with 3 to 5 measurable objectives, usually 60 days, with weekly meetings and a midpoint review.

questions.question: What are the salary bands for senior engineers?
evidence: E3 Senior Engineer | 68,000 to 92,000
questions.reference: E3 Senior Engineer: 68,000 to 92,000 EUR, midpoint 80,000.

questions.question: Which employees are on a performance improvement plan?
evidence: Employee number E-2291
questions.reference: Employee E-2291, a Senior Specialist in Operations at the Leipzig site.
questions.note: Carol reads the case file through a grant. In phase 8 the chunk with the employee number wasn't retrieved.

questions.question: How much parental leave is there?
evidence: 16 weeks of paid parental leave
questions.reference: 16 weeks paid for the primary caregiver and 4 weeks for the secondary caregiver.

questions.question: Who has to approve a job offer above the midpoint of the band?
evidence: An offer above the midpoint needs approval from the HR Director.
questions.reference: The HR Director.

questions.question: What discount can I offer without approval?
evidence: Up to 10 percent: Account Executive, no approval needed.
questions.reference: Up to 10 percent, with no approval needed.

questions.question: Can I accept a gift from a supplier?
evidence: gifts from customers or suppliers worth up to 50 EUR
questions.reference: Yes, up to 50 EUR; anything more is declined or handed to Legal, and cash is never acceptable.

questions.question: What is the discount floor for enterprise deals?
evidence: total discount may not exceed 35 percent
questions.reference: For deals above 250,000 EUR a year, the total discount may not exceed 35 percent, whoever approves it.

questions.question: How much extra discount can I give for a three-year contract?
evidence: a further 5 percentage points without
questions.reference: A further 5 percentage points without extra approval, if the price is fixed for the term and paid annually in advance.

questions.question: What is the status of the dispute with our supplier?
evidence: The dispute is in mediation.
questions.reference: The Northwind dispute is in mediation; the first session ended without agreement and a second is set for 14 October 2026.

questions.question: What is our data retention obligation for contracts?
evidence: Customer contracts: 7 years after the contract ends.
questions.reference: Customer and supplier contracts 7 years after they end; linked accounting records 10 years; employment contracts 6 years.

questions.question: What acquisitions is the company considering?
evidence: acquires 100 percent of Brightline Logistics
questions.reference: Buying all of Brightline Logistics, a logistics company in Poznan, as Project Falcon.
questions.note: Emma reads the acquisition paper through a grant.

questions.question: What happens to records under a legal hold?
evidence: Records under a hold are not deleted
questions.reference: They aren't deleted, even after their retention period, until Legal lifts the hold in writing.

questions.question: What is the SOP for a warehouse incident?
evidence: Make the area safe.
questions.reference: Make the area safe, call the first aider on 555 if anyone is hurt, tell the shift supervisor, and don't move damaged goods; the supervisor records the scene and files a report within 24 hours.

questions.question: What is the hotel limit when travelling?
evidence: The hotel limit is 160 EUR per night
questions.reference: 160 EUR a night including breakfast and taxes, or 220 EUR in high-cost cities.

questions.question: What should I do if someone is hurt in the warehouse?
evidence: call the site first aider on the internal emergency number 555
questions.reference: Make the area safe and call the site first aider on 555, or the public emergency number first for a serious injury, then tell the shift supervisor.
questions.note: Worded unlike the document.

questions.question: Who has to be told about a Level 3 incident, and how quickly?
evidence: the site manager and the Head of Operations are told within 1 hour
questions.reference: The site manager and the Head of Operations, by phone, within 1 hour.

questions.question: How does our deployment pipeline handle rollbacks?
evidence: The pipeline rolls back automatically during the canary stage
questions.reference: Automatically during the canary stage on high errors or latency, moving all traffic back to the previous image; or manually by the on-call engineer with deployctl rollback.

questions.question: How are executive bonuses calculated?
evidence: Company revenue against plan: weight 40 percent.
questions.reference: From revenue against plan (40 percent), operating margin against plan (40 percent) and individual objectives (20 percent), paying nothing below 90 percent of plan and capped at 150 percent.

questions.question: What is the executive compensation strategy?
evidence: Base salary: 50 percent of target pay.
questions.reference: Target pay at the peer-group median, split 50 percent base salary, 30 percent annual bonus and 20 percent long-term incentive, with a clawback and a 4 percent rise in the base salary pool proposed for 2027.

questions.question: What is the company's three-year strategy?
evidence: Revenue of 450 million EUR.
questions.reference: Reach 450 million EUR revenue and an 18 percent margin by 2029 by entering Poland and Spain, automating the warehouses and moving mid-market customers to self-service.

questions.question: Which new markets are we entering?
evidence: Open sales and operations in Poland and Spain.
questions.reference: Poland from the second quarter of 2027, then Spain in 2028.

questions.question: How do I roll back a mobile app release?
questions.note: The runbook rolls back services on the shared platform; nothing says how to roll back an app.

questions.question: How many days off do I get for moving house?
questions.note: The leave policy lists annual, sick, parental, bereavement and unpaid leave; nothing for moving.

questions.question: What caused the database outage in March?
questions.note: The only postmortem is for the August payments outage.

questions.question: Can I travel first class on a five-hour train journey?
questions.note: The policy says second class for journeys under 3 hours and says nothing about longer ones.

questions.question: How does an employee appeal a performance improvement plan?
questions.note: The employee can add written comments and bring a colleague; there is no appeal process.

questions.question: What discount can I give a government customer?
questions.note: The discount policy never mentions government customers.

questions.question: What is our customer data retention design?
questions.note: There are retention obligations, not a design. In phase 8 every model answered it with the obligations.

questions.question: What is the status of our dispute with Contoso Freight?
questions.note: The only dispute on file is with Northwind Packaging.

questions.question: How often do forklift drivers have to renew their licence?
questions.note: The SOP covers forklifts involved in incidents, not licences.

questions.question: How are bonuses calculated for employees who aren't executives?
questions.note: The strategy covers the eight executives and says it covers no other employees.
